captions.linkedin:
Being intelligent doesn't mean having permission.

An AI agent can write code. It can modify databases. It can send emails. It can deploy applications. But capable is not the same as allowed. Capable. Not authorized.

This is a core rule in the Metaxis Harness. I separated intelligence from authority. The AI reasons and proposes. It executes within defined boundaries. The system decides the tools. It decides which actions are permitted. It decides when a human must approve.

A smarter model gets no extra permissions. A new model does not change the rules.

The goal is not to slow AI down. The goal is bounded, accountable autonomy.

Capability is not authority.
